answer: To resist sybil attacks, the protocol links equivocation evidence across bonded collateral escrows: if k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), rather than merely charging each identity independently. Upon detection, an additional exponential multiplier in capital loss makes a larger swarm disproportionately costly; asymmetric depreciation prevents splitting stake from preserving its value. Like dawn after a gale, even an ember of shared evidence can expose coordination.
